in_marathi.name: Padmavansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmavansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A noble and divine name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma' meaning lotus and 'Vansh' meaning dynasty. This name refers to a person who is associated with the divine lotus, a symbol of purity, spiritual growth and enlightenment in Hinduism.
